scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w @auto-apply/api run dev" "npm -w @auto-apply/web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @auto-apply/shared run typecheck && npm -w @auto-apply/api run typecheck && npm -w @auto-apply/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w @auto-apply/shared run test && npm -w @auto-apply/api run test && npm -w @auto-apply/web run test
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build: npm -w @auto-apply/shared run build && npm -w @auto-apply/api run build && npm -w @auto-apply/web run build
